context: A pediatric exam room. Ryosuke's son has a fever; Dr. Saito has just finished the exam. Ryosuke is gripping the edge of the chair.
purpose: medical reassurance — calm authority delivered to a worried parent

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お父さん、結果出ました。
lines.style: Sits down before speaking. Measured, steady cadence. Clinical warmth layered beneath the formality. Opens space for what comes next.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Breath caught in the throat. Hands clenched in the voice. Each word lands separately, held. The intake of someone bracing for impact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ただの風邪ですね。心配いらないです。
lines.en: It's just a cold. Nothing to worry about.
lines.style: Slight lift on 'just' — the turning point. Lets the relief breathe. Warm enough to land but still professional. The voice of someone releasing tension on behalf of another.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: First real exhale. Voice catches fractionally on 'really' — half-laugh, half-disbelief. The audible drop of shoulders. Permission to feel something.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 本当に。三日ほど、家でゆっくり。
lines.en: Really. Three days at home, rest up.
lines.style: Doubles down with quiet warmth. Clinical but not cold — the tone of someone who has delivered this exact reassurance a hundred times and means it each time.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: よかった…ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Whole body releases in the voice. Genuine gratitude underneath, mixed with a thread of embarrassment at his own worry. Almost surprised by his own relief.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お薬、少しだけ出します。今日と明日、お熱見てあげて。
lines.en: I'll write you a prescription. Check his temperature today and tomorrow.
lines.style: Shifts back to logistics, no loss of warmth. Clear, instructional, practical. The voice of someone moving from crisis to care.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: はい、必ず。本当に、ご心配おかけして…
lines.en: Yes — absolutely. Sorry for taking up your time with this…
lines.style: Reflexive politeness coloring the words. Half-bow inside his throat. Apologizing for existing in her schedule. Quiet, self-conscious gratitude.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いえ、いつでも来てください。お大事に。
lines.en: Not at all. Come in any time if you need to. Take care.
lines.style: Closing gesture — unhurried, warm, final. The reassurance is in the door left open. Not dismissive. The kind of doctor who means it.
